pin_limit: Reuse existing fixed local snapshot and original candidate index SHA; no new archive/tree/blob-to-commit verification claimed. Same limitation as preceding accepted Botania snapshot.

mechanism.capture: Only native spawner block is eligible. Server obtains SpawnerBlockEntity, writes saveWithFullMetadata into mover spawner subtag before destroyBlock(pos,false). Destroy return ignored. Cooldown20 and success trigger follow; client branch only particles. Native block with missing BE still returns capture success without data.
mechanism.reader: SpawnData.CODEC result with nested entity id and ResourceLocation.tryParse selects capture vs placement. Parseable unknown registry ID still selects placement; tooltip registry optional lookup is separate. Malformed/missing data routes capture and is not deleted merely by reader.
mechanism.place: Build temporary vanilla spawner ItemStack and run substituteUseTrackPos, computing BlockPlaceContext actual offset position. On consumesAction, server shrinks mover before obtaining destination BE; only actual SpawnerBlockEntity receives copied payload with x/y/z rewritten then load. Reader checks only SpawnData ID but writer transfers full metadata.
mechanism.custody_helper: With player, save held stack, substitute temporary stack, construct fresh context, call useOn, restore saved stack after normal return. Null-player context explicitly supported. No try/finally; exception recovery not guaranteed.
mechanism.test_source_only: Existing GameTest source creates pig spawner, captures, checks hasData/air, places and checks spawner present/mover empty. It does not assert pig identity, full payload or unchanged metadata after reload; not executed.

limits: No same-version native ItemStack/BaseSpawner/BlockItem implementation located under tools/cod4; native API treatment of consumed-stack getTagElement and placed spawner load/sync/dirty not independently traced. Do not assert crash/duplication occurs.
No independent post-load setChanged/update packet in local consumer; cannot conclude absent synchronization without native parent.
World destroy, item write and item consume/block load not disk-atomic. Missing BE or failed destroy callbacks can leave custody gaps; only source ordering observed.
Full spawner payload is world-block custody, not authorized player Clone whitelist, old-ID registry remap or crafting history. No extra credit per metadata key, helper, test or spawner species.

dedup_comparison.distinction_proposed: Unlike moving minecart inventory bridge or converting paid staged spawner into percent core: same full native spawner metadata changes custody world->physical unstackable item->new world position via actual vanilla placement substitution. Requires independent semantic decision; generic codec alone not extra credit.
